headline: EU flash PMIs mixed for November 2026
summary: The Eurozone November 2026 flash PMI readings came in mixed, providing a mixed signal for European economic activity. Manufacturing remained in contraction while services held slightly above the neutral 50-level. The data was not strong enough to significantly influence European Central Bank rate expectations.
key_facts: EU flash PMIs mixed for November 2026
Manufacturing PMI below 50 (contraction)
Services PMI marginally above 50
Limited impact on ECB rate expectations

headline: Dollar eases from 19-month high as market confidence shows early signs of recovery
summary: The US Dollar Index pulled back slightly from its 19-month high of 103.97 (set November 19) to trade near 103.65-103.74 on November 23 as risk sentiment recovered modestly. The DXY had strengthened for four consecutive weeks driven by safe-haven demand during the equity selloff and the Fed's hawkish turn.
key_facts: DXY eased from 19-month high of 103.97 (Nov 19)
Four consecutive weekly DXY gains
Safe-haven demand and Fed hawkishness cited as drivers

headline: Stock Market Today, Nov. 23: Markets See a Boost After Last Week's AI Selloff
summary: US equity markets were staging a broad premarket relief rally on November 23 following last week's AI-sector selloff that pushed the S&P 500 and Dow into correction territory. The rebound was broad-based, with chips, mega-cap tech, and the broader market all participating in the early session gains.

headline: South Korea finance minister says government ready to activate market stabilization fund
summary: South Korean Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il said the government is preparing to activate its 10.76 trillion won stabilization fund as the KOSPI's decline deepens, financed by contributions from financial institutions. While the activation timing and final size are yet to be determined, officials said procedures are being readied for immediate launch if needed.
key_facts: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il says fund ready to activate
10.76T won ($8B) fund financed by financial institutions
Size and launch date still to be determined
Fund will buy index-linked products and equities
Crack down on illegal short selling also announced
